name: cabinet
description: Radek's Claude Code plugins: GitHub issue filing and other repo rituals

plugins.name: issue-maker
plugins.description: Create or update a GitHub issue for the current repo: validates the task against the code, searches for duplicates, writes a feature-level description, sets labels, type, effort and priority.

plugins.name: release-bump
plugins.description: Cut a release: bump the version by semver from the changes since the last tag, compact the Unreleased changelog into tight entries, and bring docs and skills in line with the code.
